interventions.detail: Pinned numpy<2 because gym 0.26.2 uses np.bool8, which NumPy 2.0 removed and which crashed env.step()
Used a uv-managed Python 3.10 venv (README supports 3.7-3.10) instead of the system Python 3.12
Installed the cloned repo in editable mode (pip install -e /work/gym) instead of pip install gym from PyPI, so the cloned version is the one imported
